note: Zoom on the blank chalkboard ledge on the mint-green wall of the alphabet room (cartoon style). Feminine words on the left (la phrase = the long toy train, l'orthographe = the giraffe with a pencil); masculine on the right (le mot = the moth on a little book, l'accent = the man in a beret). Divider offset to 790 because the giraffe stands just right of centre. The blank card on the wall is the sign.
